ar.title: الكيكة الاسفنجية

steps.n1: يخفق البيض جيدا مع السكر حتى يغلظ قوامه ثم نضع الفانيليا.
steps.n2: يضاف الدقيق مع البيكنج باودر إلى خليط البيض والسكر المخفوق بخفة وتدريجيا حتى يختفي الدقيق.
steps.n3: يصب الخليط في صينية مستديرة مدهونة ثم يخبز في فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى النضج.
steps.n4: تستعمل هذه الكيكة في عمل التورتات المختلفة.

en.title: Sponge Cake

steps.n1: Whisk the eggs thoroughly with the sugar until the mixture thickens, then add the vanilla.
steps.n2: Gradually fold in the flour and baking powder into the whisked egg and sugar mixture gently until the flour is fully incorporated.
steps.n3: Pour the mixture into a greased round cake pan and bake in a medium-heat oven until done.
steps.n4: This cake is used to make various types of layered cakes and tortes.

legacySteps: Whisk the eggs thoroughly with the sugar until the mixture thickens, then add the vanilla.
Gradually fold in the flour and baking powder into the whisked egg and sugar mixture gently until the flour is fully incorporated.
Pour the mixture into a greased round cake pan and bake in a medium-heat oven until done.
This cake is used to make various types of layered cakes and tortes.
